Underlying_Architecture: Integral Images + Rectangular Haar Features + Adaboost Cascade
Observed_Strengths: Extremely lightweight and fast CPU execution; zero GPU or deep learning requirements.
Genuine_Failure_Or_Limitation: Observed 1 False Positive on building/window lattice in photograph due to rectangular intensity symmetry; Missed pedestrians/riders in video because distant; tilted; or occluded faces lack rigid frontal Haar patterns.

column7: Deep Convolutional Neural Network with C2f feature extractors and anchor-free detection head
column8: Detects diverse objects simultaneously across varying scales; orientations; and partial occlusions with high confidence.
column9: High confidence detections require substantial model weights; does not detect non-COCO entities (such as rainbow; buildings; or cloud formations) without custom fine-tuning.
